comparison.objective: Refit a loaded drawer onto roller slides and pull-test it, versus collet-nut preassembly.
comparison.physical_skill: Carry a large drawer above riding height, clear rear hooks and lower onto slides; candidate performs small-part eccentric capture and tilt-roll insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Drawer must ride correctly and survive a pull test; candidate must remain retained for 3 seconds and resist light withdrawal. Candidate pull magnitude is unspecified.
comparison.reason: Both verify retention by pulling, but their alignment mechanisms and tested manipulation abilities differ substantially.
